summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three keyword rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py) with matching unit-test modules in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. The 87 ECS unit tests pass when run with the reference interpreter and PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src. Full test/unit has one failure (test_build_graph, missing pygraphviz/pydot in the venv) and test_formatters.py cannot be collected (missing defusedxml); neither was installed. Four integration tests fail: quickstart exit code 12 vs 14 on openshift.yaml and the junit formatter subprocess. No E3052-E3054 findings appear on that template, but I did not run the suite without my change to confirm the failures are pre-existing. Fixed one bug during testing: E3053 paths carried a stray NetworkMode segment. Nothing committed. No black or ruff in the venv, so formatting was checked by line length only.
